messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Just driving back from OULU-07 after a quick routine check near TRN-045. Are you up for some lunch today Anu?

messages.author: Anu Virtanen
messages.text: Hey Timo! Yes, definitely. By the way, just heard that our Thursday planning meeting got moved to Friday at 13:00.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Oh thanks for the heads up, Friday afternoon is always a classic time for planning. How about we head to the canteen at 11:30? It's soup day today!

messages.author: Anu Virtanen
messages.text: Perfect, 11:30 works great. I really need a break, been fighting with the office coffee machine again.

messages.author: Timo Laine
messages.text: Haha, that coffee machine is easily the least reliable device on our entire network. It needs a complete hardware swap.

messages.author: Anu Virtanen
messages.text: Absolutely, it has a 90% packet loss on espresso delivery! See you at 11:30 at the canteen :)
